title: Start, loop, and stop.
description: Start one loop, retain its handle, and let its release finish.

title: Play one step on the right surface.
description: Choose a surface before playback starts, then let the graph choose and trim one variation.

title: Follow a moving sound source.
description: Start a looping buzz once, move its Transform, and adjust its pitch without replacing the play.

title: Shape a running sound with parameters.
description: Send a new target to an existing play and let the graph smooth the change in pitch or layer volume.

title: Send a command to a running graph.
description: Use Horn, Work, or Strike to trigger another path inside a play that is already alive.

title: Schedule thunder and cancel the whole storm.
description: Place each thunder at its strike point, let the graph delay it, and use one owner to clear pending and audible weather sounds.

title: Switch tools and overlap a hammer tap.
description: Reuse one main Workshop play and a second tap play, with typed selection and ordered signal responses.

title: Handle busy sounds without a retry storm.
description: Read request results, count replaced plays through notifications, and keep event limits separate from voice capacity.

title: Crossfade two allowed music tracks.
description: Supply Track before playback, fade through two retained handles, and retire the outgoing play only after it becomes silent.

title: Pause every play in an interaction.
description: Pause current and outgoing music together, and distinguish that local pause from the service-wide pause used by Launch.

title: Compare Stop and Detach.
description: Destroy a temporary sound owner and hear whether its departure cue ends or stays at the last position.

title: Wait for clearance and launch on sound completion.
description: Keep a sequence alive while conditions are unmet, then use its matching Finished notification to start a following flight sound.
